title: Physical completion of the Navier-Stokes equations
summary: The incompressible Navier-Stokes equations contain viscous dissipation but no thermal noise. I show, using a topological argument based on Poincaré's lemma, that the fluctuation-dissipation relation for the full nonlinear dynamics can be derived without the linearisation or structural assumptions that all previous derivations require.
